[[AdvoCare Invitational]] champions |tourney= [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2018–19 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Villanova University]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Jay Wright (basketball)|Jay Wright]] in his 18th year, the Wildcats played their home games at the [[Finneran Pavilion]]{{cite press release|url=http://www.villanova.com/genrel/021417aac.html |title=Board of Trustees Approves Pavilion Renovation |publisher=[[Villanova Wildcats]] |date=February 14, 2017 |accessdate=March 30, 2017}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.vuhoops.com/2017/2/14/14612240/villanova-basketball-finneran-pavilion-renovation-announced-60-million|title=Villanova Basketball Pavilion Renovation Approved|work=VU Hoops|access-date=2017-07-14}} on the school's campus in the [[Philadelphia]] suburb of [[Villanova, Pennsylvania]] and [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 26–10, 13–5 in [[2018-19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in first place. They defeated [[2018–19 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]], [[2018–19 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]], and [[2018–19 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] to win the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game?gameId=401120748|title=Seton Hall vs. Villanova - Game Summary - March 16, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-01}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2019-big-east-tournament-bracket-scores-villanova-defeats-seton-hall-wins-third-straight-conference-tournament-title/|title=2019 Big East tournament bracket, scores: Villanova defeats Seton Hall, wins third straight conference tournament title|website=CBSSports.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-01}} As a result, the Wildcats received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 6 seed in the South region.{{Cite web|url=http://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/sports/Selection-Sunday-College-Basketball-Villanova-Temple-March-Madness-Tournament-507274871.html|title=Villanova Earns 6 Seed, Temple to Play in First 4 Game|website=NBC 10 Philadelphia|language=en|access-date=2019-10-01}} There they defeated [[2018–19 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123400|title=Saint Mary's vs. Villanova - Game Recap - March 21, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-01}} before being defeated by [[2018–19 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] in the Second Round.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123432|title=Villanova vs. Purdue - Game Recap - March 23, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-10-01}} ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 36–4, 14–4 in [[2017–18 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in second place. They defeated [[2017–18 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]],{{Cite news|url=https://www.foxsports.com/wisconsin/story/marquette-golden-eagles-falls-to-villanova-94-70-in-big-east-tournament-030818|title=Marquette falls to Villanova 94-70 in Big East tournament|date=2018-03-08|work=FOX Sports|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en-US}} [[2017–18 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]],{{Cite news|url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/butler/2018/03/09/villanova-overpowers-butler-87-68-big-east-semifinal/410925002/|title=Insider: Butler powerless against Villanova in Big East semifinal|work=Indianapolis Star|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}} and [[2017–18 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] to win the [[2018 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] championship.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2018/03/10/villanova-tops-providence-for-2nd-straight-big-east-title/32825969/|title=Villanova tops Providence for 2nd straight Big East title|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}} As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 1 seed in the East region, their third No. 1 seed in four years.{{Cite news|url=http://www.philly.com/philly/sports/colleges/villanova/villanova-march-madness-2018-bracket-ncaa-tournament-seed-20180311.html|title=March Madness: Villanova earns No. 1 seed in East region in NCAA tournament, will play LIU-Brooklyn or Radford - Final in Three Seasons|last=Schonbrun|first=Zach|date=2018-03-31|work=The New York Times|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en-US|issn=0362-4331}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2018/04/01/villanova-beats-kansas-final-four-march-madness-national-championship|title=Villanova overpowers Kansas from three in Final Four rout|work=SI.com|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}} before defeating [[2017–18 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] in the [[2018 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|National Championship game]] to win their second national championship in three years.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401025888|title=Michigan vs. Villanova - Game Recap - April 2, 2018 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2018-04-06}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/wolverines/2018/04/03/ncaa-title-game-michigan-villanova/480762002/|title=Michigan basketball can't solve Villanova, special season terminated|work=Detroit Free Press|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}} They won every game of the tournament by a double-digit margin and the team's tournament run has been called among the most dominant ever.{{Cite news|url=https://fivethirtyeight.com/features/the-only-opponent-villanova-has-left-is-history/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180403162259/https://fivethirtyeight.com/features/the-only-opponent-villanova-has-left-is-history/|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 3, 2018|title=The Only Opponent Villanova Has Left Is History|last=Paine|first=Neil|date=2018-04-03|work=FiveThirtyEight|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en-US}} ==Offseason== ===Coaching changes=== Following the season, longtime assistant coach [[Ashley Howard (basketball)|Ashley Howard]] left the Wildcats to become the head coach at [[La Salle Explorers men's basketball|La Salle]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/23081918/la-salle-explorers-hire-villanova-wildcats-assistant-ashley-howard-coach|title=La Salle hires Nova assistant Howard as coach|work=ESPN.com|access-date=2018-05-22}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
